message: I remember the time I was whipping up dinner and my smoke alarm decided it was the perfect moment to go off. Of course, my phone was dying, and I couldn't check my escape plan or look up how to silence the alarm! 😅 It made me realize how important it is to have those things written down somewhere handy, just in case. Now, I keep a little note on the fridge with our escape routes and safety tips. It’s a small step, but it gives me peace of mind. Have you ever had a tech fail at the worst time?
